task.title: Reject format controls in gateway URLs
task.objective: Reject hidden Unicode formatting characters and undecoded non-ASCII bytes in configured and returned gateway URLs
acceptance_criteria: Zero-width and bidirectional format controls are rejected in base and stream URLs
Undecoded non-ASCII raw URL bytes, including UTF-8 BOM bytes, are rejected
Failures preserve pre-credential, pre-transport, and pre-mutation ordering

attempts.summary: Added base-origin and stream-URL regressions for U+200B, U+2066, and raw UTF-8 BOM bytes
attempts.diagnostic: The focused regression accepted a stream URL containing U+200B

attempts.summary: Extended URL character validation to Unicode format controls and undecoded non-ASCII bytes

outcome.summary: Configured and returned gateway URLs now fail closed on invisible format controls and undecoded Unicode bytes

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1107

lessons: URL safety checks must account for invisible Unicode semantics as well as visible delimiters
Reject undecoded high bytes rather than allowing representation differences to bypass character validation
